description: TY2026: accumulated earnings tax, SS 531/535. Taxable income 600,000 (line 30 given) -> federal income tax 126,000 subtracted (SS 535(b)(1)); dividends paid 100,000; accumulated earnings credit = max(reasonable needs 0, 250,000 - 50,000 prior E&P) = 200,000. Accumulated taxable income = 474,000 - 100,000 - 200,000 = 174,000 -> 20% = $34,800.00.
